messages:
morgan: Quick flag  I found debug captures that saved raw request text alongside embeddings. Potential PII exposure (example: SSN/email) in the embeddings index.
lee: Crap. Repro steps?
sara: Can we get a sanitized example flow (no real data) so product/console UX folks can design for it?
morgan: Repro: client sets X-Debug-Inspect=true, capture config had persist_original=true & persist_embedding=true. We call embed(text) then write {orig_text, embedding} to the debug blobstore. Console shows 'view original' when inspect enabled.
vikram: Our scrubbing pipeline only touches logs, not the embeddings store. Index is searchable and used by rerankers.
lee: Is this limited to debug/canary tenants? Scope please.
morgan: Mostly debug captures and a handful of canary tenants that enabled inspect for testing. Not global, but existing blobs are the issue.
sara: Requirements: default deny raw text persistence, preview must be safe, and lawful access should be auditable and gated.
devex: UX idea: redacted preview + "Request original (audit)" button which opens a ticket and triggers a gated decrypt.
vikram: Engineering thoughts: three possible approaches:
- Pre-embed redaction (mask PII before embedding)
- Encrypt original with tenant KMS and require audited unwrap
- Store only hashed or synthetic provenance metadata with embedding
Each has tradeoffs: masking affects similarity, KMS unwrap adds latency/ACL complexity, hashing prevents replay.
lee: Proposal (short-term): default persist_original=false, add redaction_level: "none|partial|full", run lightweight regex scrub pre-embed as cheap fallback. Canary a small tenant set.
morgan: Long-term: store encrypted original (tenant KMS) + surface only redacted preview; audited unwrap via console triggers ACL + KMS decrypt + audit log. Also plan a backfill scrub job for existing blobs.
sara: I'll mock console states: (1) Redacted preview + confidence score, (2) Request unwrap -> show audit form -> on approval show original with overlay watermark.
vikram: Backend tasks: pre-embed hook, regex scrub PR, feature-flag ML PII model, KMS encryption integration, backfill job for old blobs. Sampling: limit persist_original to 0.1% during canary.
lee: SRE: I'll own canary rollout, quota caps, and a migration runbook. Need to measure latency impact of pre-embed scrub (expect ~5-15ms).
morgan: Compliance/legal: will ping after RFC draft. Also opened infra ticket PLT-8012 for backfill planning.
oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall runbook and incident playbook for audited unwrap requests.
devex: One more ask: update quickstart to warn about debug inspect default values and to call out embedding persistence.
morgan: Action items summarized: RFC (morgan), console mock (sara), SRE canary + quotas (lee), pre-embed scrub + PR (vikram), compliance ping (morgan), backfill ticket (PLT-8012).
sara: +1 :thumbsup:
lee: +1
vikram: I'll open the initial PR and tag reviewers.
morgan: Will post RFC link in this thread when ready. Keeping thread for updates.
